svg.title: SkyQ Sigma S on SPY, 24-year account value
svg.desc: Hypothetical account value of a $1,000,000 account trading a fixed 1,000 shares of SPY with the Sigma S systematic intraday model from September 2003 to November 2026, with net profits retained as cash and not reinvested. The account ends at $3.59M.
svg.text: Account value with profits retained as cash · not compounded
